subject: Request: Verification of Sept 17 service disruption for invoice adjustment
messages:
From: Alex Lu <alex@brightcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Finance <billing@brightcart.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected availability gap on 2028-09-17 — invoice impact

Hi Jordan,

We noticed a sustained availability gap on our integration between 09:02 and 09:26 PDT on 2028-09-17 that caused retries and several failed checkouts on our side. Our billing team flagged a spike in token usage and a related charge on the Sep invoice. Can you confirm whether this window qualifies for an SLA remedy and what the process is for getting an invoice adjustment?

I attached a screenshot from our monitoring and a line-item export from our billing (invoice_line_items_brightcart.xlsx). Needed details:
- Confirmation of the exact Redwood service window you observed
- Eligible credit amount or calculation approach
- Expected turnaround for applying any adjustment to our invoice
- Any evidence or postmortem we should expect to see

We'd appreciate a quick acknowledgement and an initial path forward — finance is asking for next steps by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Alex
Account Ops — BrightCart
--- attachment: BrightCart_downtime_screenshot.png (image/png) ---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Lu <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 Sep 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected availability gap on 2028-09-17 — invoice impact

Hi Alex — thanks for flagging and for the artifacts. I'm looping in Vivek (SRE) to validate the precise service window and Marissa from Customer Success to coordinate credits and billing next steps.

Prelim notes:
- We have a monitoring alert that aligns with the morning spike; I don't yet have the confirmed start/end timestamps for eligibility.
- We will need to pull raw traces and routing logs to validate whether this meets the SLA definition of an availability incident (and whether it was mitigated by fallbacks).

Vivek & Marissa — can you prioritize an evidence pull and confirm whether the incident meets SLA-credit criteria? Alex, we'll aim to reply with a formal determination and calculation by 2028-09-19 COB.

Jordan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Alex Lu <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected availability gap on 2028-09-17 — invoice impact

Alex / Jordan / Marissa — quick update from SRE after an initial evidence pull.

What I ran:
- Queried request logs for BrightCart tenant for 2028-09-17 08:45–10:00 PDT
- Pulled per-shard error rates, upstream routing errors, and autoscaler events
- Checked prefix cache hit rates and any fallback model substitutions

Prelim findings (short):
- We observed an elevated 503 spike from 09:04:12–09:24:57 PDT (approx 20m 45s) clustered in a single host pool serving your region
- Autoscaler initiated a scale-up but backfill latency and connection churn extended the windows before capacity stabilized
- There were no traffic-shaping overrides or customer-configured rate-limit rules in effect that would explain this on your side

Next steps and needs from BrightCart:
1) If you can share any client-side correlation IDs (or the request_id column in your line items) that will let us map individual failed requests.
2) I'm attaching the compressed raw trace bundle for 09/17 that includes server-side traces and kernel-level timings (redwood_raw_traces_2028-09-17.zip). This has the logs we'll use to formally compute downtime eligibility.

Expected timeline:
- I'll complete the formal eligibility check and an availability window verification by 2028-09-19 15:00 PDT.
- If eligible, Marissa will draft the credit calculation and proposed invoice adjustment.

--- attachment: redwood_raw_traces_2028-09-17.zip (application/zip) ---

Vivek
Principal SRE — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Lu <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected availability gap on 2028-09-17 — invoice impact

Alex — thanks for the patience. We completed the eligibility review and have the remediation steps. Summary below: 

Summary of findings
- Confirmed service degradation window (as measured by gateway 503 responses): 2028-09-17T16:04:12Z through 2028-09-17T16:24:57Z (20m 45s) — corresponds to the times you reported (PDT timestamps).
- Event classified as an SLA availability incident per section 3.2 of the contract (impact to successful request rate across your tenant).

Credit & billing path
- Credit calculation: per SLA, we compute a prorated monthly credit equal to 10% of the monthly committed usage for every 30 minutes of downtime beyond the 5-minute grace window. For your committed plan we calculate a 6.9% credit for September (calculation detail attached).
- Next steps: We will issue an invoice adjustment (credit memo) to BrightCart's account. Finance will apply the credit to your Sep invoice within 7 business days after you accept the calculation.

Evidence & postmortem
- Attached: redwood_raw_traces_2028-09-17.zip (server traces) and a short evidence summary.
- We will publish a public postmortem (summary + remediation actions) by 2028-09-26 and share the draft with your team before publication. Internal Jira: INF-4512 contains the full RCA and remediation plan: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4512

Request from BrightCart
- Please confirm acceptance of the calculated credit and whether BrightCart Finance would like the credit applied as a memo to the Sep invoice or as a straight refund.
- If you want us to include the client-side correlation IDs in the credit memo, attach the requested request_id column from your export.

If you accept, I'll route the credit memo through finance and confirm once the adjustment is applied.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
